description: Our name is a tribute to the historic Apollo 13 mission by NASA in 1970. While the astronauts famously said "Houston, we have a problem," our team flips the narrative. Facing the challenge of microgravity combustion, we are here to say: "Houston, we have a solution." Combining physics, engineering, and data analysis, we aim to accurately model the behavior of a spherical flame in free fall to contribute to the future of space safety and orbital research.
